Ticks per 100 swings depend on how long mobs live, not on the proc rate. Dungeon trash dies inside the disease's 14 sec, and the sim's mob lives all fight. The proc rate itself (22% of landed hits, Nov 13) is in the sim as 3.9 PPM.
